a: A small fraction of NOEMA and 30-meter observing time
dt: Proposals may be submitted at any time through the IRAM Proposal Management System; give at least two weeks' notice for non-ToO requests
e: IRAM's channel for target-of-opportunity events, urgent or high-impact follow-up, and small tests of new ideas at millimetre wavelengths. Proposals must explain why they were not submitted at the regular deadline.
unv: The DDT page does not state PI eligibility; IRAM's regular calls reserve a share of time for PIs outside the partner countries.
